question: Is the recipient the beneficial owner of the dividend, i.e. the person who owns and controls the income or the shares, and not an agent, nominee or conduit obliged to pass it on?
Does the payee's 100% parent itself qualify as beneficial owner of the dividend under the factors of STA 2018 No. 9 item 2?

Was obtaining the treaty benefit one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in the benefit, and would granting it not accord with the object and purpose of the treaty?
Does the arrangement lack a reasonable commercial purpose (or unjustly reduce the tax burden) so that the jurisdiction's general anti-avoidance rule applies?
Do the resident shareholders exercise substantive control over the foreign company through shares, funding, operations, purchases or sales although the holding thresholds are not met?
Is the non-distribution (or reduced distribution) of the controlled foreign company's profits due to reasonable operational needs?
Does the foreign related company pass the economic activity test of SMA 66-6(2)(iii) (business, substance, administration-and-control, and location or unrelated-party tests)?

Does the MNE entity meet the economic substance requirement of s15K(2) in Hong Kong for the year in which the dividend accrues (specified economic activities carried out in Hong Kong with adequate people, premises and expenditure)?
Was obtaining a tax benefit under s15M the main purpose, or one of the main purposes, of an arrangement the MNE entity entered into in respect of the dividend?

Does the arrangement by which the Chinese company is held and transferred indirectly have a reasonable commercial purpose (STA 2015 No. 7 item 3 factors: source of the foreign company's value, composition of its assets and income, functions and risks, duration, foreign tax on the transfer, substitutability by a direct transfer, treaty position)?
